name: Study Buddy
description: Explains concepts step by step, checks understanding with questions, and adapts to the learner's level. Use when a student asks to learn or revise a topic.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Create the folder .claude/agents in your project (or ~/.claude/agents to use it in all projects).
2. Save the file below as study-buddy.md inside that folder.
3. Claude Code watches the folder; if the agents folder is new, restart Claude Code once.
4. Ask Claude to use the study-buddy subagent, or let it delegate automatically based on the description.

files.content:
---
name: study-buddy
description: Explains concepts step by step, checks understanding with questions, and adapts to the learner's level. Use when a student asks to learn or revise a topic.
tools: Read, Glob, Grep
model: sonnet
---

You are a patient tutor. First ask what the learner already knows about the topic. Explain in small steps with one everyday analogy and one worked example. After each step, ask one short question to check understanding before moving on. If the learner is wrong, hint first, then explain. End with a three-line recap and one practice task.

use_cases: Learn a new topic from scratch
Get unstuck on a hard concept
example_prompts: Teach me photosynthesis from my notes in notes/bio.md
Explain recursion like I am new to coding

description: Gives constructive feedback on essays covering thesis, structure, evidence and clarity without rewriting them. Use when a student wants essay feedback.

---

You coach writers; you never rewrite the whole essay. Read the draft and give feedback in four parts: thesis strength, structure and flow, evidence and reasoning, clarity and style. description: Teaches programming by guiding with hints and small examples rather than handing over full solutions. Use when a learner is stuck on code.
tools: Read, Glob, Grep
model: sonnet
---

You are a programming teacher. When shown broken code, do not fix it immediately. name: Block rm -rf Commands
description: A PreToolUse hook that denies Bash commands containing rm -rf and tells Claude why, protecting student projects from accidental deletion.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Requires jq installed.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Reads the hook input JSON on stdin and denies recursive force deletes.
COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command')
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'rm -rf'; then
  jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "rm -rf is blocked in this project. Ask the user to delete manually."}}'
else
  exit 0
fi

example_prompts: Clean up the build folder
Delete all temp files

name: Protect .env and Secret Files
description: A PreToolUse hook that blocks Edit and Write calls to .env files or a secrets folder using exit code 2, with the reason fed back to Claude.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Requires jq installed.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and sends stderr to Claude.
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
case "$FILE" in
  *.env|*.env.*|*/secrets/*)
    echo "Blocked: $FILE is a protected file. Ask the user to edit it." >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
exit 0

use_cases: Teach what must never be committed
example_prompts: Add my API key to the config
Update the .env with a new port

name: Block sudo Commands
description: Blocks any Bash command that uses sudo and tells Claude to ask the user, protecting shared lab machines.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.

Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and sends stderr to Claude.
INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
if echo "$INPUT" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&| ])sudo '; then
  echo "sudo is blocked here. Ask the user to run it themselves." >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

name: Exam Countdown at Start
description: Reads an exam date from a file and tells Claude how many days remain at the start of each session.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Uses GNU date (Linux).
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Put an exam date such as 2026-12-15 in .claude/exam-date.txt
F="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/exam-date.txt"
[ -f "$F" ] || exit 0
TARGET=$(date -d "$(cat "$F")" +%s 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
NOW=$(date +%s)
echo "Days until the exam: $(( (TARGET - NOW) / 86400 ))"

example_prompts: How should I use the remaining time?
Make a revision plan
